questions.question: How many spies did Moses send to explore Canaan?
What did most of the spies report about the land?
options: It was small and not worth the fight
It was good but full of giants
It was barren, with no food or water
It was empty and free for the taking
questions.answer: It was good but full of giants

questions.question: Caleb urged the people to go up and take the land, trusting God.
The spies brought back a single cluster of _____ carried on a pole between two men.
Ten spies gave a bad report, but Caleb and _____ trusted God.
